style_contract.rendering: 2D anime cel shading with clear colored outlines, matte materials and limited broad shadow bands
style_contract.lighting: soft upper-left key, no photographic highlights or dramatic cast shadows
style_contract.characters: approximately 3.5-4 heads tall, same camera and foot line; build changes width/mass rather than arbitrary scale
style_contract.environment: matching hand-drawn material treatment; overhead square-grid camera must be corrected before final gameplay integration
style_contract.colors: teal, cream, brass and brown world materials; hair/class accents may differ
style_contract.approval: manual review required per asset; generation success is not approval
style_contract.review_gate: Require an approved cross-category pilot (character, building, prop, item) before expanding replacement production. Matching palette alone is insufficient.
style_contract.pixel_finish: Shared pixel density, colored edge treatment and material ramps at gameplay size; resolution-study targets are provisional, not final delivery sizes.
